title: Static-body free-air external flow construction
description: Scenario-1 static-body free-air external flow, registered stage by stage so the formal MCP path can drive the SAME macro chain the verified restricted-trial pipeline ran (cases/static-sphere-external-flow/pipeline-e2e-geometry-to-validation.json). build-body creates the geometry; audit-body, build-domain, region-physics-mesh, mesh-quality-audit, solve and validation are the six stages of that verified chain, with the identical macros, the identical per-macro handoff and the identical required artifacts. IMPORTANT: the six stage declarations below have NOT themselves been executed or reviewed as formal stages - the evidence is macro-chain level (the trial ran these macros in this order through a reviewed runner). A formal run requires its own review record pinning the runner, the macros and the input. Nothing here creates a region, sets physics or solves except the stages that say so.

build-body.description: Create one closed static body part (sphere) with explicit CaseSpec SI origin and radius in a simulation that has no parts and no regions; verify the STAR read-back, then save a geometry-only .sim.

audit-body.description: Read-only audit of the geometry-only static-body .sim: part identity, closed/manifold/tessellation and measured raw-coordinate extents. Creates no region and never initializes.

region-physics-mesh.description: THREE macros in one stage, one STAR process each with its own exit code, chained by macro_outputs: BuildExternalFlowRegion (region + boundary roles from CaseSpec boundary_roles) -> ConfigureExternalFlowPhysics (continuum and boundary values from the CaseSpec) -> BuildExternalFlowMesh (volume mesh from the CaseSpec mesh sizes).

inherited_inputs.why: BuildExternalFlowRegion reads external_domain_build.json to bind body-boundary ownership to the audited single subtracted part; without the file it throws after writing a probe. Measured in formal-pat18-full-chain-20261019c: the upstream external-domain-2502/build stage succeeded and its record stayed in its own stage directory, so the region stage must inherit it by declaration. external_domain_built.sim is already carried as the next stage's input .sim and is not duplicated here.
inherited_inputs.enforced_by: worker/run_pipeline.ps1 (source stage must be an earlier SUCCEEDED step of THIS run) + worker/run_job.ps1 (hash re-verified and refused before STAR starts)

mesh-quality-audit.description: Read-only measured mesh quality on the SAVED mesh (Cell Quality, Face Validity, Volume Change, prism layers), gated against the CaseSpec thresholds. It does not export y+ and does not repair the mesh.

solve.description: Bounded, chunked steady solve on an isolated copy: finite state, residual and monitor history exported, checkpoint saved, honest convergence verdict. It does NOT claim convergence.
solve._time_budget_note: 2026-10-14 用户撤销全部时间预算；本轮执行层落地。求解阶段的 env 不再声明 EXTERNAL_FLOW_BUDGET_SECONDS：不传该键时宏缺省 0，表示不以墙钟停止，停止依据为数值门/迭代上限/诊断。历史运行记录的 480 s 只描述当时的请求。

validation.description: Read-only convergence verdict against the CaseSpec gates on the SAVED solution. It CHECKS convergence; it does not make a solution converge and it establishes no engineering validity (the round-10 verdict is NOT_VALIDATED_NO_REFERENCE).

inherited_inputs.why: the audit reads external_flow_solve.json for the stage-1 force/imbalance/finite_state cross-check, external_flow_solve_history.csv for the chunk_history drag window (the only drag series that exists on this install) and stage-solve.json for the read-only hash proof. Without them it can only report NOT_CONVERGED_UNMEASURED - measured in round 14 (round14-formal-layout-finding.json).
inherited_inputs.enforced_by: worker/run_pipeline.ps1 (source stage must be an earlier SUCCEEDED step of THIS run) + worker/run_job.ps1 (hash re-verified and refused before STAR starts)

solve-transient.description: Fresh-clock URANS in an isolated copy; all inner residuals and physical-step loads exported, segmented checkpoint. Execution success is not E. No steady residual gates or wall-clock stopping.

_registered_chain: build-body -> external-domain-2502/build -> audit-body -> region-physics-mesh -> mesh-quality-audit -> solve -> validation. The domain stage lives in external-domain-2502 because it is shared with the rotating cases; a run names it as a second step with its own workflow_id.
_not_registered_on_purpose: domain_study / mesh_study are NOT stages here: window-1 is implementing them (test-evidence/static-external-flow/round13-*) and they are declared in operations/catalog.json as reserved interfaces. time_step_study has no implementation and is not registered anywhere.
